messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: P1 - 'ACME private agent heartbeat lost'. Customer: acme-corp. Private control plane reports missed heartbeats from on-prem agent (region: eu-west-1). Pager: https://pager.example/INC12345

pagerduty: Pager fired to oncall (mike_oncall). Escalation in 5m to se-oncall if no ack.

mike_oncall: ack - taking. assigning ticket INC12345. quick status: are customers seeing 502s or timeouts?

jess_eng: saw retries from acme earlier, their traffic started tripping 504s ~5m ago. logs show ‘no route to host’ when proxy tried to reach agent.

liam_sre: I'm on network checks. starting with VPC peering/route table and control-plane health. @eng-private can you confirm control plane nodes healthy?

eng-private: control plane metrics green, control API healthy from our side. No rollout in last 24h. most recent control->agent pings show 200 until 1799994200, then heartbeats stopped.

mike_oncall: ok, looks like connectivity drop at ~1799994200. customer-impact: ACME's private app returns ENDPOINT_UNREACHABLE for inference requests. CS is already patched. @customer-success please confirm message sent.

customer-success: notified ACME engineer. they confirm degradation since ~12:34 UTC. asking for ETA.

liam_sre: running quick checks from bastion into customer's VPC via transit gateway.

liam_sre: ```
ssh -i /secrets/bastion.pem ubuntu@bastion.eu-west-1.redwood
sudo tcpdump -ni eth0 host 10.3.2.14 and port 8443 -c 50
```

liam_sre: tcpdump shows SYNs leaving bastion but no SYN-ACK back from on-prem agent IP 10.3.2.14. route table looks ok. could be firewall on customer edge or their on-prem agent down.

jess_eng: can we reach the agent heartbeat endpoint from control plane? trying curl to agent via control tunnel.

eng-private: ```
curl -v https://10.3.2.14:8443/health --connect-timeout 5
* TCP_NODELAY set
* connect to 10.3.2.14 port 8443 failed: Connection timed out
```

mike_oncall: timeouts both ways. next step: request customer to check on-prem agent process and edge firewall. I'll open a bridge with ACME.

customer-success: ACME ops on the bridge now. they say their on-prem host was recently patched and rebooted 10m before incident. they saw the agent service fail to start.

jess_eng: that matches. ask them to check service logs: `sudo journalctl -u redwood-agent -n 200` and send lines around segfault / port bind errors.

ACME-ops (via bridge): pasted logs to bridge: "redwood-agent[2245]: error: failed to bind to 0.0.0.0:8443: address already in use" then later "redwood-agent[2245]: segfault at 0 ip ..."

liam_sre: interesting — double symptom: both bind conflict and segfault. maybe stale process + kernel module mismatch post-update. recommend restart sequence and run agent with debug.

mike_oncall: propose mitigation steps: 1) stop existing agent process 2) ensure port free 3) restart agent 4) if segfault persists, run agent binary under gdb or capture core and revert kernel patch.

jess_eng: sharing commands for them:```bash
sudo systemctl stop redwood-agent
sudo ss -ltnp | grep 8443  # find pid holding port
sudo kill -9 <pid> || true
sudo systemctl start redwood-agent
sudo journalctl -u redwood-agent -f
```

ACME-ops: performed stop/start. first start hung for 30s then core dumped again. they pushed a temporary change to systemd to start agent with --safe-mode flag. now agent started and heartbeat resumed.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Heartbeats for agent 10.3.2.14 resumed at 1799994678. Control plane reports full connectivity.

mike_oncall: verified control plane -> agent health, and endpoint test from our API gateway shows successful inference handshake. @customer-success pls confirm ACME sees recovery.

customer-success: ACME confirms traffic recovered and responses normal. they rolled back the kernel patch for the node and will coordinate a safe upgrade plan.

liam_sre: capture artifacts for postmortem: agent logs, core dump, system journal, package list, kernel version. I'll scp logs off the customer's bastion for analysis.

jess_eng: creating follow-up runbook item: add health-check fallback that tries a different port if 8443 conflict detected and improve agent start idempotency. tagging eng-private and runtime teams.

mike_oncall: set severity to P1 -> mitigated. updating incident ticket and notifying SE leads. timeline: detection 1799994200, mitigation 1799994678.

eng-private: rolling quick config change to agent installer to detect leftover processes and emit clearer diagnostics (non-blocking). will open PR.

mike_oncall: handing off to night oncall in 15m. @liam_sre you're primary for follow-ups, jess will own the postmortem writeup. I'll update stakeholders and close when postmortem linked.

ops-bot: reminder: create postmortem doc template: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/INC12345-template

mike_oncall: thanks all. marking this thread as resolved for live mitigation. continuing follow-up offline. :thumbsup:
